rca_of_issue: RCA (resolved by main agent): homeFor() in src/auth.tsx redirects EMPLOYEE+FIELD_AGENT to '/dist', but the app/dist/ route group had never been added to the repo, so expo-router returned the default +not-found screen ('Unmatched Route'). Fix: added app/dist/_layout.tsx (RoleTabs with 4 tabs) + app/dist/{index,sale,customers,ops}.tsx (thin re-exports of existing /src/screens/{Overview,NewSale,Customers,DistributorOps}). Verified: /dist and all 4 nested tabs render; no 'Unmatched Route' on any role home; backend endpoints used by these screens all 200.
